div.div: • At least three ready Kong replicas spread across AZs with topology spread, PDBs and tested spare capacity for one AZ loss. Replica count alone is not resilience.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 438px; height: 1px; padding-top: 420px; margin-left: 1212px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;

div.div: • Platform owns Gateway/GatewayClass, allowedRoutes, baseline plugins and private Kong administration; applications own namespaced HTTPRoutes only.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 438px; height: 1px; padding-top: 535px; margin-left: 1212px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: • Kong -> application hop is TLS/mTLS. No Amazon API Gateway or Konnect. DB-less uses Git/Kubernetes desired state, not decK sync.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 438px; height: 1px; padding-top: 650px; margin-left: 1212px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#232F3E, #bdc7d4); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div: • Aurora has a single regional writer; storage replicates across AZs. Global Database to R is asynchronous: AZ-loss zero loss is not regional zero RPO.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 438px; height: 1px; padding-top: 765px; margin-left: 1212px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;

div.div: • In R before promotion: Aurora secondary readers replace the writer and payment submitters stay disabled; everything else is pre-provisioned.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 438px; height: 1px; padding-top: 880px; margin-left: 1212px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;

div.div: • Terraform owns AWS provisioning; Helm owns Kubernetes workloads; LB Controller owns its ALBs. Never declare a resource twice.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 438px; height: 1px; padding-top: 995px; margin-left: 1212px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #232F3E;

div.div: • AZ-a/b/c are logical slots: map actual AZ IDs per account. Confirm EKS, endpoint, backup and engine support in both regions (S6, S33).
